title: Sync current GitHub main and publish Bridge UI/runtime
description: CRITICAL DEPLOY TASK. GitHub machxanht/BridgeChatgpt main is the source of truth. The currently published https://bridge-ai-mission-control.ai.studio is visibly stale: Android Bridge v0.5.0 WebView still shows the old Mission Control dashboard and therefore may also be running stale backend code. Sync the exact current main HEAD, including commit 5cc02cea987156e798a1c8961e2368efa2b6d4ae (exact-target single-flight + bounded Android recovery) and the current compact UI source. Do NOT preserve/restore older Studio workspace copies over GitHub. Verify the main screen from current source is the compact shell: compact BRIDGE header; project chips with active project clearly ACTIVE; Add Project collapsed by default; one compact active-project context module for repo/branch/Studio/ChatGPT targets; Bridge Chat as the dominant area; composer available in the chat flow; System Details collapsed by default with old Mission Control inside it. No mock data. Resource Registry, Wake Engine, backend routes, tasks/messages and exact target routing must remain real. Run npm run lint, npm test, npm run build, then production startup smoke /health. If all pass, PUBLISH this exact Studio app/resource id 15c1d80d-6265-47e1-bdf2-e30fb7bf430c so https://bridge-ai-mission-control.ai.studio serves the synced HEAD. After publish, reload the published URL and visually verify the old large dashboard is no longer the main screen. Re-register/heartbeat this exact Studio target only if publish resets registry state. Do not create any additional smoke task. Do not modify Android APK in this task. Report the deployed commit SHA and whether published UI visually matches the compact shell. If sync/publish is blocked, mark this task blocked with the exact reason instead of looping.
